clips.title: The story
paras: Bethor Iceshard sends his enchanted message back to Gunther Arcanus on Brightwater Lake. The stolen spellbook may bring his old Kirin Tor companion into the Forsaken fold.

Bethor Iceshard sends an arcane message to Gunther Arcanus through a stolen spellbook. Once Bethor learns the necromancer on Brightwater Lake is his old companion, he enchants the tome's pages. The spell leaves Bethor's own magical mark, showing he is active in Lordaeron and free of the Lich King's control.

Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Bethor Iceshard, Gunther Arcanus, and Thule Ravenclaw studied and became friends in the Kirin Tor of Dalaran. When the Lich King rose, Thule betrayed his companions and joined the Scourge willingly. Bethor and Gunther fell to the Plague. Bethor later broke free alongside Queen Sylvanas. Believing Gunther dead or enslaved, Bethor now learns his old friend has also won his own freedom and seeks to bring him to the Forsaken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.
Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King. It is good to know he is free.
We must have him. I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King. After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!

clips.title: Completion
paras: My book?!? So you were the thief who stole it!
But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor? He is in Lordaeron?
If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
